scope: DI+DO source rationale supporting root880-footprint audit; does not replace root full-board inventory

24_DI.reason: Twelve independent dual receivers preserve24general DI. Per-channel field thresholds/current/filter/bias differ from twelve motor alarms and two fast probes. Local bypass capacitors are not rack-power duplicates.
24_DI.open_gaps: Sensor-power limiters/monitoring and real acquisition MCU remain outside this120-part frontend. No inherited rack identity or connector is fitted.

16_DO.reason: Four quadTPS devices are the minimum for16outputs. Two isolators preserve separateFIELD_A/B power-return domains. Two rearm latches record independent permission drops/reset; merging them couples domains. Each channel has a source-backed external reverse-blocking FET and output capacitor. Current measurement uses the existingTPS internalADC, with no separate fake ADC/MCU perquad.
16_DO.open_gaps: No fitted field connectors, field supply converters/entry/bulk, MCU, identity chip or status LED. Current POR1.25A must not be described as an implemented0.72A setting.

DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.candidate: One logic8-gate AND package instead of two4-gate packages
DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.reason_not_removed: Current two packages use3gates each. A reviewed8-gate part with independently allocated inputs and safe partial-power behavior could reduce1IC, but changes source/package/pin mapping and all bypass/layout tests. No exact replacement is selected.

DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.candidate: One dualDFF instead of two singleDFF packages
DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.reason_not_removed: Separate clear/Q functions must remain. Requires an exact true dualDFF with verified pinmap/reset/power and package; SN74LVC2G74 is a SINGLE8-pinDFF and is not this optimization.

DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.candidate: Delete resistor biases on actively driven nodes
DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.reason_not_removed: Only acceptable after complete driver leakage, partial-power/reset/high-Z review. Inputs such as fieldDOEN and MCU-controlled enables must defaultOFF. No bias is waived by a future firmware claim.

DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.candidate: Combine per-IC decoupling into one global capacitor
DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.reason_not_removed: Not a valid source-count optimization; local return inductance and TI VDD stabilization requirements survive one-board consolidation.

DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.candidate: MergeFIELD_A/B ground/power or share one isolator/latch
DO_consolidation_candidates_not_applied.reason_not_removed: Would eliminate the inherited two independent field/isolation/permission domains; not a like-for-like cost reduction.
Removes protected output electrical functions and changes cable/load qualification. No approved omission.

IOL1_three_MCU_rationale.three_nodes: L0DIC24DI class0x11, L1DOA8DO class0x21, L2DOB8DO class0x21; three soldered functional regions, no cards.
IOL1_three_MCU_rationale.reason: Retains three independent point-to-point IOL1 SPI slaves with100us periods and parallel59.6us processing windows, plus two independently isolated TPS SPI masters. One STM32G031 has only twoSPI peripherals; it cannot provide3host slaves+2driver masters. Sharing links or one larger MCU changes protocol/peripheral allocation/processing and common-failure domains; it is not a harmless rack-remnant deletion.
candidates_not_applied: Four extra CARD_EN/STROBE pull-downs in the unintegrated13xxx source duplicate four already-fitted10xxx biases on the final same nets; one reviewed physical10k per net is sufficient. Remove the duplicate source owners only during integration/review, not from either frozenfrontend now.

Three separate rail supervisors keep MCU IWDG/NRST resets local. A common rail supervisor plus properly isolated open-drain fanout may consolidate supply monitoring while preserving local resets; direct tying of allNRST pins is not equivalent.

Four slot bits per node inherit IOL1 electrical straps. Restricting current0–2 IDs to two physical bits can remove6resistors/free6GPIO but requires an explicit revised pin/identity contract. No fake card presence or always-healthy straps are permitted.
IOL1_three_MCU_rationale.evidence: Source only; no target firmware, programmed option bytes, factory identity or physical timing proof.
